gloss: the nations; the powers; countries of the world

definitions.gloss: the nations; the powers; countries of the world
definitions.explanation: A collective term for the nations of the world, especially in the context of international relations or diplomacy. Often implies major or influential countries.

examples.japanese: {列国|れっこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{協力|きょうりょく}する→協力する：25370_kyouryokusuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{列国|れっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Representatives of the nations gathered at the conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幕末|ばくまつ}→幕末：12531_bakumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{列国|れっこく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開国|かいこく}→開国：14660_kaikoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}った→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the Edo period, the foreign powers pressured Japan to open its borders.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal and somewhat literary term. Often used in historical contexts to refer to Western powers (⟦{列強|れっきょう}→列強：11776_rekkyou⟧ is a near synonym emphasizing military might). Common in discussions of international diplomacy and historical events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {列国|れっこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (representatives of the nations)
- {列国|れっこく}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (relations among nations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{列強|れっきょう}→列強：11776_rekkyou⟧: the great powers — emphasizes military and political power, often used historically
- ⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧: various countries — a broader, less formal term
